thread:
maria (PM): Quick sync — we need to settle scope for the March milestone. My proposal: split into two phased gates so we can ship an MVP earlier and de-risk the harder pieces.
maria (PM): Gate A = core text generation, auth, basic telemetry. Gate B = reranker, prefix KV cache, and model variant routing.
drew (Eng): sounds reasonable. main risk is KV cache + reranker coupling. If we cut reranker from Gate A, perf for our largest ACME use-case drops ~20%.
alex (Eng-Platform): We can ship KV cache as a lightweight opt-in feature behind a flag. That would let Gate A include cache core without full evictions/compaction work.
lisa (Sales): ACME is pushing for the perf story — they asked for reranking before pilot. If we delay reranker to v1 we risk the deal. Jordan, do they care about partial rollout?
jordan (CSE): ACME said partial rollout is OK if we provide a hard SLA for the pilot cohort and explain known gaps. They care most about latency and deterministic ordering more than cache internals.
maria (PM): Ok — option A: keep reranker in Gate A and delay KV cache (more engineering for reranker). Option B: keep KV cache in A as opt-in, run a simple rerank heuristic in A (fast, lower accuracy), full reranker in B.
drew (Eng): Option B seems safer for schedule. Heuristic rerank (e.g., boosting by keyword + lightweight scorer) is ~2w dev + can be iterated. Full reranker is ~5w with evals and infra.
sam (Product Ops): Timeline note — if we accept Option B we still need an explicit rollback plan and canary gates. Suggest rollout plan: 1) internal canary, 2) ACME pilot cohort, 3) broader opt-in.
maria (PM): Agree. Draft acceptance criteria for Gate A (quick):

```
- Core text gen passes perf SLOs (p95 < 300ms for pilot workload)
- Auth + telemetry enabled for pilot orgs
- Heuristic rerank enabled and validated on top-100 prompt set (quality delta < 10%)
- Feature flag + rollback path in place
```

maria (PM): Gate B acceptance criteria (summary): full reranker, KV cache with compaction, model routing rules, + canary to 5% traffic.
lisa (Sales): If we go Option B, I'll tell ACME we'll deliver Gate A for pilot with opt-in cache and heuristic rerank, and Gate B in the following release. They'll want target dates.
alex (Eng-Platform): From infra POV, opt-in cache needs a config flag at launch and a monitoring dashboard. ETA for that work is 1 week if we parallelize with dev on heuristic.
drew (Eng): Team can do heuristic + feature flag in parallel. Full reranker will be scheduled for sprint+2. Need PM sign-off to deprioritize non-blocking infra work.
maria (PM): Sounds good. Decision: move forward with Option B (opt-in KV cache + heuristic rerank in Gate A). I'll update the milestone tracker and notify stakeholders. @lisa please confirm messaging to ACME.
lisa (Sales): Confirmed. I'll send ACME a short note today and propose pilot start window 3/22 - 3/29. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: New release branch created: release/mar-gateA (2348765440)
sam (Product Ops): I'll add canary steps to the release checklist and create the two milestone tickets (Gate A / Gate B) in the roadmap board.
maria (PM): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short doc and the updated acceptance criteria. If anything urgent, ping me here
